title: Strict support-system comparison before total limit
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E/Q_l, a field K₀ with IsUnit(l:K₀), finite-type quasi-compact K₀-schemes X,Y, a separated finite-type quasi-compact K₀-morphism f:X→Y and a compactification c of f. Fix Operations o on strict coefficient systems [def-sf-integral-system-operations]. Let T and e be exactly the functor and evaluation comparisons chosen by exists_compactSupportReductionTower [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor]. There is a natural isomorphism from calculus(X).reduction followed by o.shriek(c.i), o.push(c.g) and strict completed scalar restriction to T on the entire integral derived category. For each integral input K and finite exponent n+1, its evaluation followed by e_n equals coefficientRestrictedEvaluationIso followed by restricted supportEvaluation and compact support applied to reductionEvaluation at K. No constructibility or reconstruction-unit assumption is required.

source.place: Primitive tensor reassociation, evaluation and adjunction unit/counit comparisons; agent-formulated component of lem-sf-integral-basic-realization.

proof.text: Construct the explicit native open and direct isomorphisms, and obtain their finite evaluation identities from integralNativeOpenComparison and integralNativeDirectComparison. Whisker and compose these two whole-system isomorphisms to b. Naturality of the given proper evaluation moves the evaluated open comparison past the proper evaluation; the two primitive identities then identify evaluated b followed by compactSupportSystemEvaluation with supportEvaluation.

Use qcqsCompactSupport_nativeTowerComparison with calculus(X), so that its reduction functor and reductionEvaluation are exactly the fixed ones. Eliminate hT and he to retain the original chosen tower and original chosen evaluations. Whisker b by fixed input reduction and completed scalar restriction and compose with the inverse native-tower comparison. Its evaluated identity follows by cancellation of that comparison, naturality of coefficientRestrictedEvaluationIso, functoriality of restriction, and the previously proved evaluation identity for b. This constructs a map of whole derived strict towers before any evaluation and uses no faithfulness of finite derived evaluation.

theorem integralSupportStrictTowerComparison (K₀ : Type u) [Field K₀]
    (o : Operations l E)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of K₀))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of K₀))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of K₀))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of K₀))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (hl : IsUnit (l : K₀)) (c : Compactification f)
    (T : Integral l E X ⥤ coefficientSequenceRestrictedDerived l E Y)
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ,
      T ⋙ coefficientConstantTowerEvaluation l E Y n ≅ compactSupportRestrictedLevel l E c n)
    (hT : T = Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
      (exists_compactSupportReductionTower l E K₀ X Y f hl c))).2.2)
    (he : HEq e (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
      (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (exists_compactSupportReductionTower l E K₀ X Y f hl c))).2.2).2).2)) :
    ∃ tower : (calculus l E X).reduction ⋙
        Operations.shriek l E o c.i ⋙ Operations.push l E o c.g ⋙
          coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction l E Y ≅ T,
      ∀ (K : Integral l E X) (n : ℕ),
        (coefficientConstantTowerEvaluation l E Y n).map (tower.hom.app K) ≫
            (e n).hom.app K =
          (coefficientRestrictedEvaluationIso l E Y n).hom.app
              ((Operations.push l E o c.g).obj
                ((Operations.shriek l E o c.i).obj ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K))) ≫
            (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E Y n).map
              ((supportEvaluation l E o c n).hom.app ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K) ≫
                (sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate
                  (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) c).map
                  (((calculus l E X).reductionEvaluation n).hom.app K))
